title: Java: from the first compile to reliable applications
summary: 36 sequenced lessons with explanations, worked examples, six inspectable exercises and separate reference solutions. Content becomes runnable only when its complete authored set is registered.

lessons.title: From source file to running JVM
lessons.outcome: Explain and apply from source file to running jvm with explicit assumptions and failure handling.
lessons.lab: Work through source examples and compare normal, boundary and invalid cases.
lessons.verification: Inspect the exact expected results and failure cases in the authored guide; process success alone is not mastery.
